INITIATIVE_ATTACK.positive_rule: A rider makes a clearly observable sustained acceleration or advance intended to take or materially improve the front/controlling position relative to the current formation.
exclude: minor speed matching without position intent
final metres sprint already classified as FINAL_SPRINT_OR_OVERTAKE
INITIATIVE_ATTACK.eligible_denominator: observable rider-phase opportunity in which the rider can materially advance position

INITIATIVE_CONFLICT.positive_rule: Two or more riders or groups simultaneously contest control/initiative such that neither simply follows the other and the conflict persists beyond a momentary overlap.
exclude: ordinary single-file following
brief wheel overlap without contest
INITIATIVE_CONFLICT.eligible_denominator: observable phase with at least two plausible initiative actors or groups

BANTE_FOLLOW.positive_rule: A rider in the following role visibly maintains the wheel/position directly behind the line leader through a material acceleration or tactical change.
exclude: rider is not in a following role
mere same-group membership without observable following challenge
BANTE_FOLLOW.eligible_denominator: observable material leader acceleration/change while a defined follower is attached

BLOCK_OR_POSITION_DEFENSE.positive_rule: A rider visibly changes lateral/longitudinal position to defend a wheel or impede a competing rider's attempt to take that tactical position.
exclude: ordinary curve line choice
incidental drift without an identifiable positional contest
BLOCK_OR_POSITION_DEFENSE.eligible_denominator: observable attempted overtake/position incursion where defensive action is possible

POSITION_COMPETITION.positive_rule: Two riders visibly contest the same tactical wheel/slot for a sustained interval, including side-by-side or repeated positional pressure.
exclude: ordinary pass with no contested slot
uncertain camera angle
POSITION_COMPETITION.eligible_denominator: observable approach to an occupied tactical slot by another rider

LINE_FRAGMENT.positive_rule: A previously identifiable line or group loses ordered wheel continuity by a material gap, displaced rider, or split that persists beyond a brief elastic gap.
exclude: momentary small gap immediately closed
group was not previously identifiable
LINE_FRAGMENT.eligible_denominator: observable identifiable line/group exposed to material pace or positional stress

SWITCH.positive_rule: A rider abandons the prior wheel/group and intentionally attaches to or targets a different rider/group after the prior relationship is lost or strategically left.
exclude: initial formation before a prior attachment exists
mere overtaking without new attachment
SWITCH.eligible_denominator: observable rider who has lost or left a prior attachment and has an alternative attachment opportunity

REATTACH.positive_rule: A rider that was visibly detached from its relevant line/group closes the material gap and restores ordered following continuity.
exclude: never materially detached
joins a different group, which is SWITCH
REATTACH.eligible_denominator: observable detached rider with a recoverable gap to the prior group

SOLO_TRANSITION.positive_rule: A rider previously in an identifiable line/group becomes tactically independent with no sustained wheel relationship to that group or another group.
exclude: rider was already solo in the initial observed formation
temporary gap followed immediately by reattachment
SOLO_TRANSITION.eligible_denominator: observable rider currently attached to a group with a plausible detachment transition

FINAL_SPRINT_OR_OVERTAKE.positive_rule: In the final race phase a rider makes an observable maximal/near-maximal finishing acceleration or passes a rider for finishing position.
exclude: earlier initiative move
position changes caused only by an incident or non-competitive slowing
FINAL_SPRINT_OR_OVERTAKE.eligible_denominator: observable rider entering the final sprint phase

line_state_format.description: Ordered groups of car numbers as directly observed on track at that moment, not reconstructed from finish.
line_state_format.rule: UNKNOWN is mandatory when camera coverage or identity is insufficient.

denominator_contract.rule: Every event-rate numerator must have an explicit eligible and observable opportunity denominator using the event-specific eligible_denominator rule.
denominator_contract.unobservable: UNOBSERVABLE opportunities are missing data and are excluded from both positive and negative counts.
